name: forbid recently made moves
mechanism: move to the best neighbour even if worse, but keep a short list of recent moves or attributes that may not be reversed for a number of steps, so the search is pushed out of the basin it just left

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Tabu search' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms:

fails_when: tenure too short cycles, too long blocks the return to good regions
